source.title: Hippocampal place cell remapping occurs with memory storage of aversive experiences

confidence_rationale: The scopolamine manipulation is what raises this above the general aversive-remapping literature: it dissociates PERCEIVING the shock from REMEMBERING it, and remapping tracks the memory, not the stimulus. That is precisely the distinction MECH-023 needs -- residue is supposed to be laid down by what was committed and retained, not by transient aversive input. Rodent calcium imaging with n=14 and a within-subject design is solid; the ceiling is set by the fact that remapping is a representational change, not a demonstrated change in what the animal will subsequently commit to.
failure_signatures: Remapping is correlated with memory formation, not shown to cause the subsequent avoidance behaviour; a REE experiment that found residue-driven rank divergence without any behavioural consequence would be in the same evidential position.

Neutral barriers produced significantly LESS remapping than shock, but not zero -- so a non-aversive change of the state's affordances also perturbs the map. The MECH-023 design's B arm (harm-free path of equal length) must therefore be matched on affordance change, not only on path length, or the noise baseline is inflated.

Scopolamine is a systemic anticholinergic and blocks encoding broadly; the dissociation it buys is 'remembered vs forgotten', not 'harm vs non-harm', so the paper does not isolate a harm-specific accumulation channel.

mapping.source_claim_statement: In freely behaving rats trained on a food-reward path preference and then shocked on the preferred short path, CA1 place cells remapped significantly more following shocks that were remembered than following shocks rendered amnestic by pre-shock scopolamine; neutral barrier insertion produced significantly less remapping than aversive shock.
mapping.ree_translation: This is the accumulation half of MECH-023's substrate. ARC-013 holds that residue is persistent latent-space curvature; here an aversive event on a specific path produces a persistent, memory-gated reorganisation of the map over exactly that space. The scopolamine arm maps onto the MECH-094 gate REE already enforces at the ResidueField.accumulate boundary: content that is not committed to the viability map does not deform the geometry. In the rat, a shock that is not encoded does not deform the map either.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The rat's remapping is measured in the representation and its behavioural consequence (avoidance) is reported at the level of the trained preference, not at the level of a ranked candidate set. MECH-023 requires the divergence to show up in E3 candidate ranking at a MATCHED state with identical non-residue surfaces -- a control the rodent preparation cannot run, since a shocked and an unshocked rat differ in far more than their residue field.
mapping.source_context: Rat CA1 miniscope calcium imaging (n=14), linear-track path-preference task with mild footshock conditioning and a scopolamine (1 mg/kg) amnestic arm.

confidence_components.notes: The memory-gating result is the load-bearing part and is the part most directly analogous to a REE architectural commitment (the hypothesis_tag refusal in accumulate). Weighted accordingly rather than averaged.
